name: White Barn Inn, Auberge Collection
insider_take: This historic Maine inn has been welcoming guests since 1860 and sits in the charming seaside village that's home to the Bush family compound.
whats_special: The White Barn Inn's restaurant holds the rare distinction of being Maine's only Forbes Five-Star and AAA Five-Diamond dining establishment. The property features beautifully restored 19th-century buildings with European-style luxury, and you're just minutes from Walker's Point, the famous Bush family retreat that has hosted world leaders.
pro_tip: Book dinner at the signature White Barn Restaurant well in advance - it's consistently ranked among America's top hotel restaurants and the rustic barn setting with crystal chandeliers is unforgettable.
dont_miss: A stroll through Dock Square's boutique shops, lobster rolls at The Clam Shack (a local institution since 1968), and sunset views from Goose Rocks Beach. The inn's location puts you at the heart of one of New England's most picturesque coastal communities.
pros: Award-winning fine dining restaurant with exceptional culinary experiences
Intimate luxury boutique property with personalized service
Prime Kennebunkport location near scenic coastal attractions
Historic New England charm with elegant accommodations
cons: Limited availability due to boutique size
